verdict.language_detail: MATLAB (namespace package +io, uses containers.Map, strcmpi, fgets, sscanf, etc.)
verdict.provenance_detail: Hand-written MATLAB function in the BNT (Brain Navigation Toolbox) repository for reading legacy Raymond-format input files
verdict.purpose: Reads metadata from a legacy 'Raymond' input file format describing neural recording sessions; parses session names, cut files, tetrode/unit info, arena shape, and recording system, combining entries with the same session names into unified trial structs.
